evidence.description: The initializer obtains the investment rate directly from Statistics.shared to determine the timer interval.
totalInvestedAt directly obtains Statistics.shared and uses its investment state to calculate the projected total.

candidates.explanation: InvestmentsProjection directly depends on Statistics.shared for investment calculations and timer scheduling rather than receiving the operational dependency through an explicit, replaceable boundary. These accesses use investment state, not merely shared constants or configuration.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The non-actor class exposes a static shared instance and a public mutable subscriptions array, making that instance state globally reachable without visible isolation or synchronization.

candidates.explanation: The mutable subscriptions instance property is reachable through InvestmentsProjection.shared without actor isolation or synchronization. The immutable shared reference does not protect the mutable state of its instance.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
